segments.text: O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.
God hath spoken in his holiness;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

footnotes.text: + triumph…: or, triumph thou over me: (by an irony)

segments.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?
Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

footnotes.text: + help of man: Heb. salvation, etc

segments.text: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.
